name: lib-server
description: A small HTTP kernel for Node.js: a service is a list of steps that return responses, run as a process with fixed exit codes, one started line and a graceful stop.

compatibility.note: Support is per entry point, of which there are four: the root entry (both request contracts and the service runner) and `/manifest` are Node-only, while `/policy` and `/environment` import no Node.js built-in, so they also run in a browser or a web worker once a bundler includes them. The package publishes no browser bundle of its own.
